The Minor Home Repair Program provides
services that contribute to a safe and secure
living environment for Franklin County seniors.
Services Include:
Minor plumbing, electrical, gas and
furnace repairs
Installation of safety devices (Smoke
alarms, deadbolt locks, etc.)
Installation of wheelchair/walker ramps
Installation of handrails and/or grab bars
And more!
Eligibility Requirements:
Franklin County resident
Aged 60 and older
Homeowner or renter*
Income eligible
(*NOTE: Renters are only eligible for wheelchair and grab bars
installation and must be wheelchair bound. Installation is also
contingent on landlord's approval.)
